limitations: WP-01 remains in progress; WP-02 through WP-08 unstarted.

Absolute address and exact lexical equality do not establish native identity, confinement, collision freedom, filesystem acceptance or mutation authority. Parent components retain host navigation semantics.
Resource byte limits differ from filesystem path/component limits. No automatic normalization, fallback, cwd resolution, display parsing or foreign-encoding conversion.
Only tested host filesystems are qualified for the raw-encoding fixture; no universal invalid-Unicode acceptance claim. APFS refusal is preserved.
Production adapters remain read-only. Test-only creations use exclusively owned scratch directories; no production probe or mutation command added.
macOS ASan+UBSan without leak detection; Linux ASan+UBSan with leak detection; Windows ASan only.
No UI/application launched; diagnostic builds removed, verified normal build and SDK retained.
